name: Romancing the Pirate
source:
You're supposed to save your kingdom, but when you end up in the hands of a handsome pirate, will you be able to stay faithful to your mission?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你应该拯救你的王国，但当你最终落入英俊海盗手中时，你能忠于你的使命吗？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
